dossier.scp_unleashed.003.title: Biological Motherboard
dossier.scp_unleashed.003.caption: SCP-003-2 seated in SCP-003-1 during a routine inspection.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-003-2 is to remain seated in SCP-003-1 at all times. While seated it is dormant and may be handled with gloves. The pair is stored in a locked cabinet, well away from bare ground.

If SCP-003-2 is separated from SCP-003-1 and set down on any other surface, it is to be returned to the plate at once. An incubating board can still be lifted intact until it hatches. **Do not wait to see what it does.**
Any instance of SCP-003-3 is to be terminated on sight. Termination recovers SCP-003-2. Growths planted by SCP-003-3 die with it and are to be burned regardless.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-003 consists of two objects. SCP-003-1 is a slab of grey stone about the size of a serving tray, etched with fine channels and symbols that glow a faint cyan in darkness. Its upper face holds a shallow rectangular recess.

SCP-003-2 is a circuit board of green laminate that fits this recess exactly. In place of electronic components it carries seed capsules, a grid of thorns, shards of beetle shell, segmented larvae and a lobed mass of brown tissue. All of them are alive, and all of them are wired into the board's traces.
Seated in SCP-003-1, SCP-003-2 is inert. Placed anywhere else it begins to incubate. Over one to two minutes it pulses, twitches and finally cracks open, releasing SCP-003-3.

SCP-003-3 passes through three stages. The first is a pale larva that avoids people and hides while it grows. The second is a four-legged animal with a single eye, which hunts anything it can catch. After several kills it becomes the third stage: a tall humanoid crowned with branching growths. This form seeks out open ground, plants four fleshy polyps around a square and, once they ripen, raises a new SCP-003-2 at the centre.

page.title: Addendum 003-1: Colony Behaviour
page.text: When three or more instances of SCP-003-3 gather, one of them is promoted. It grows larger and sprouts a second pair of arms. The promoted instance does not build. Instead it mends the injuries of the others. No more than one has been observed at a time.

page.title: Addendum 003-2: Provenance
page.text: SCP-003 was never recovered by the Foundation. Both objects were handed to a researcher by an unidentified individual in Foundation dress, who was not seen to leave. The same individual has since approached other readers of this file. %rOrigin of the individual unknown.%r See field notes.

item.scp_unleashed.scp003_plate.tooltip: A slab of grey stone etched with faint, glowing circuitry.
item.scp_unleashed.scp003_plate.seat: Place it, then use SCP-003-2 on it to seat the board.
item.scp_unleashed.scp003_plate.lift: Sneak and use it with an empty hand to lift the board out.
item.scp_unleashed.scp003_board.tooltip: A green circuit board crowded with seeds, shells and something that twitches.
item.scp_unleashed.scp003_board.safe: Seated on SCP-003-1, it stays dormant.
item.scp_unleashed.scp003_board.active: Set down anywhere else, it wakes and begins to grow.
item.scp_unleashed.scp003.together: Never let the board touch bare ground.
jade.scp_unleashed.scp003_plate.lift: Sneak-use with an empty hand to lift the board
jei.scp_unleashed.scp003_plate: SCP-003-1 is a stone plate etched with faint circuitry. Place it, then use SCP-003-2 on it to seat the board. A seated board stays dormant.
jei.scp_unleashed.scp003_plate.lift: Sneak-use the plate with an empty hand to lift the board out. Breaking a seated plate drops both pieces.
jei.scp_unleashed.scp003_board: SCP-003-2 set down anywhere except its plate becomes active and starts to incubate.
jei.scp_unleashed.scp003_board.incubatio: Incubation takes %s to %s minutes. The board pulses, twitches and finally cracks. Breaking it before it hatches returns the board.
jei.scp_unleashed.scp003_board.stages: SCP-003-3 hatches as a larva that hides while it grows, then becomes a four-legged crawler that hunts. After %s kills it turns into a host.
jei.scp_unleashed.scp003_board.ritual: A host plants four polyps around an open 3x3 space and forms a new board at its centre. It can do this up to %s times.
jei.scp_unleashed.scp003_board.kill: Killing any stage drops the board and destroys the polyps it planted. When three or more gather, one becomes an alpha that heals the others.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp003.grow.alpha: This world already has an alpha
